title: EXPLOITING UNSUPERVISED PRE-TRAINING AND AUTOMATED FEATURE ENGINEERING FOR LOW-RESOURCE HATE SPEECH DETECTION IN POLISH
reasoning: The paper describes a technical approach for a hate speech detection competition (PolEval 2019). It focuses on model performance (F1 scores) and implementation details of BERT and ULMFiT rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
